_about: TEST RESEARCH PAYLOAD - invented for CLIVE's tests (tests/web/research.test.js). Every document, quote, idea and person in it is made up: the documents are TEST RESEARCH NOTES about an invented sock shop, and Ana Fixture is not a real person. Written to the ideas payload contract of DEC-078 by the screen builder before the backend's own example existed.
summary: 6 ideas from 3 documents; 1 waits on you; 1 being read

points: TEST POINT 1: every change to the invented test shop is read back before CLIVE says it worked.
TEST POINT 2: a log of every test parcel would let CLIVE answer where a parcel is without asking anyone.
TEST POINT 3: one test note wants test emails sent without your hold; your rules say otherwise, so that one is yours to call.
TEST POINT 4: weekly test reorders are right, but wait until the work already started is finished.
synthesis.before: a pile of separate test recommendations, each asked of you on its own
synthesis.after: one short list of test ideas, each checked against your rules and read back

needs_you.name: Test emails go out without your hold
needs_you.statement: TEST STATEMENT: CLIVE sends the invented shop's test emails to test customers without waiting for a hold on the card.

reasons.judgment: Three test notes back it, and it contradicts RULE-2, so it is your call rather than CLIVE's.
reasons.timing: It would be next if you said yes.

needs_you.how_they_differ: TEST: notes A and C want speed; note B wants the hold kept for anything a test customer sees.

against.says: TEST: a test email should still wait for a hold when it goes to a test customer.

owner_view.means: TEST VIEW: CLIVE would send the test shop's emails itself, without you holding the card first.
owner_view.today: Every test email waits on its card until you hold it.

owner_view.example: Ana Fixture (an invented test customer) asks where test order #T-0003 is; CLIVE would answer her by test email at once.

owner_view.notice: Test customers would get answers while you're away.
